title: Recognised Community Identity
status: Foundational capability; confirm live setup steps in the verified self-service guide before public demonstration.
problem: Many communities live inside WhatsApp names, paper lists and the memory of current leaders. When leadership changes, records and authority become unclear.
adds: GSN gives the community a named domain and governed identity space, separate from ordinary chat noise.
why: Identity is the root of every later action: announcements, meetings, shops, welfare, support and trust evidence.
details: The quiet difference is continuity: the community is no longer only inside one admin phone.
boundary: GSN presents organised identity evidence; it does not by itself prove legal registration.

title: Governed Membership and Joining
status: Foundational where the community wants controlled participation.
problem: Open groups collect strangers, duplicate names and silent members nobody can place.
adds: GSN supports joining paths, review and clearer member, visitor, owner and manager roles.
why: Access should follow responsibility. Controlled joining reduces confusion before sensitive activity starts.
details: Joining becomes a process, not a forwarded link that never stops moving.
boundary: Exact approvals and permissions must follow the current app implementation.

title: Invite Links and QR Entry
status: On-demand where invite or QR routes are available.
problem: Manual onboarding wastes time and still leaves doubt about who entered through the proper route.
adds: GSN can direct people through invite or QR entry points for the right community flow.
why: For meetings, events and membership drives, the entry path is part of the evidence.
details: A QR code at the door can replace passing a paper attendance sheet around the room.
boundary: QR and invite links should expose only intended public or entry surfaces, not internal admin tools.

title: Official Bulletin and Announcement Surface
status: Configurable/on-demand depending on community setup.
problem: Important announcements disappear inside chat under greetings, debate, jokes and repeated questions.
adds: GSN separates official bulletin information from ordinary conversation so notices remain findable.
why: A community needs one recognised place for the message that matters.
details: The value is not just posting; it is that the message can still be found after the day has passed.
boundary: Bulletin should stay focused on official notices unless the community deliberately changes its rules.

title: Acknowledgement, Availability and Response Signals
status: Capability direction; use only where the live product exposes these actions.
problem: After an announcement, leaders may not know who saw it, who is coming or who needs follow-up.
adds: GSN can turn notices into light response evidence such as seen, acknowledged, available or interested.
why: The difference between announcement and coordination is response evidence.
details: One acknowledgement action can replace twenty separate replies saying received.
boundary: Response signals are not proof of attendance or agreement unless that specific evidence is recorded.

title: Meeting Lifecycle Support
status: Composite capability from announcements, attendance, records, roles and documents.
problem: Meetings fail when notice, agenda, attendance, decisions, actions and follow-up live in different places.
adds: GSN can package the meeting as a recordable process before, during and after the event.
why: A meeting without memory becomes another meeting about the same matter.
details: The value after the meeting may be bigger than the meeting itself because decisions survive handover.
boundary: GSN can organise meeting evidence; it does not replace signed minutes where required.

title: Digital Attendance and Sign-In
status: Capability direction tied to QR, member and record flows.
problem: Paper attendance is slow, easy to lose, hard to read and weak months later.
adds: GSN can support sign-in patterns where people use phone, link or QR to record presence.
why: Attendance can become evidence of participation, quorum, programme delivery or volunteer presence.
details: People can sign in when they enter and, where needed, sign out when they leave.
boundary: Attendance evidence should follow consent, privacy and community rules.

title: Permanent Minutes, Decisions and Action Memory
status: Planned/composite unless the current record screen confirms full minutes support.
problem: Communities repeat decisions because old minutes, files and voice notes cannot be found.
adds: GSN can preserve decisions, action owners, supporting files and follow-up context.
why: Leadership continuity depends on memory that survives people leaving office.
details: A new executive can see what the previous executive already built instead of restarting from rumours.
boundary: Use formal storage or export for legal minutes where signed records are required.

title: Heavy Documents, Downloads and Bridges
status: Capability direction linked to bulletin, public links and attachment support.
problem: Constitutions, forms, teaching notes, reports and circulars get compressed, lost or scattered in chat.
adds: GSN can make an announcement the doorway to full documents, downloads and approved bridges.
why: Serious community work usually needs documents, not only short messages.
details: The announcement carries the short instruction while the attached file carries the full detail.
boundary: Private or sensitive files must not be exposed through public links.

title: Roles, Permissions and Approval Paths
status: Foundational governance capability; exact controls must follow current permissions.
problem: Communities suffer when everyone can post, edit or delete too much, or when one person holds all control.
adds: GSN can separate owner, admin, member and public-facing actions so responsibility follows role.
why: Good limits make participation safer and protect official surfaces.
details: Power can be shared in smaller pieces instead of giving one password to everybody.
boundary: Do not claim a permission exists until confirmed in the current route and role implementation.

title: Leadership Continuity and Handover
status: Composite capability from identity, records, roles, documents and activity history.
problem: When leaders change, communities lose passwords, files, reasons for decisions and project history.
adds: GSN helps separate the community asset from the personality of the current executive.
why: A community that cannot hand over its records cannot grow beyond one leadership cycle.
details: Retiring executives no longer carry the only copy of community memory in their phones.
boundary: Formal constitutions and legal records remain outside GSN unless uploaded or referenced properly.

title: Projects, Visits and Collective Initiatives
status: Capability direction using bulletin, roles, attendance, contributions and follow-up records.
problem: Projects fail quietly when interest, attendance, tasks, resources and updates sit in different places.
adds: GSN can connect the notice, participant response, evidence, follow-up and outcome around one initiative.
why: Projects need structure before they need noise.
details: A welfare visit, school cleanup, church programme or market sanitation can leave a useful activity trail.
boundary: GSN should not replace field verification where physical delivery matters.

title: Welfare and Support Coordination
status: Composite capability; financial handling remains non-custodial unless a lawful payment rail exists.
problem: Support requests can become emotional, duplicated, under-evidenced or unfair.
adds: GSN can structure the support request, responsible parties, evidence and follow-up without forcing everything into public chat.
why: Compassion becomes stronger when it is organised fairly.
details: The support story can move from noise to accountable care.
boundary: GSN records evidence; it does not guarantee repayment, medical outcomes or welfare success.

title: Member Business and Service Presence
status: Configurable where Shop and product/service setup are live.
problem: Members sell, repair, teach, cook, sew, deliver and consult, but the community forgets who does what.
adds: GSN gives a member shop or service profile a stable place with name, category, images, contact and community context.
why: Local economic value grows when people can find each other at the moment of need.
details: A seller is no longer introduced from memory each time; the page carries basic proof and contact path.
boundary: A shop page is presentation evidence, not a guarantee of quality or honesty.

title: Products, Services, Images and Contact Clarity
status: Foundational for shops and marketplace visibility.
problem: Small sellers lose buyers when descriptions are unclear, images are missing and contact details are scattered.
adds: GSN organises product or service details, images, price cues, WhatsApp contact and route back to the shop.
why: People decide faster when the offer is visible and understandable.
details: Picture, name, contact and community trust context sit together instead of in separate messages.
boundary: Sellers must still provide accurate information and fulfil promises.

title: Spotlight Visibility Without Chat Flooding
status: On-demand promotional capability when Spotlight is configured and active.
problem: Promotion inside a group can irritate members when the same image is reposted repeatedly.
adds: GSN Spotlight gives a promoted item controlled visual space connected to the shop and record.
why: Good visibility should create attention without damaging community trust.
details: Spotlight links promotion to shop records and DemandBox signals instead of treating it as a loose flyer.
boundary: Spotlight attention is not the same as sales; analytics must not pretend otherwise.

title: Public Sharing, QR and Repost Links
status: On-demand public-link capability where enabled.
problem: Communities need to share offers and records outside GSN, but sharing the wrong internal screen exposes too much.
adds: GSN can create controlled public views for the exact thing being shared: shop, record, bulletin or DemandBox item.
why: A good bridge brings people back to GSN without exposing private architecture.
details: The bridge should show the message or record, not the private tool used to create it.
boundary: Never expose admin controls, private graph logic or internal setup flows through public links.

title: Community Bulletin Bridge to WhatsApp and Social Channels
status: Planned/configurable governance bridge unless live integration is confirmed.
problem: The community may live daily on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram or email, but those channels should not own the permanent record.
adds: GSN can treat external channels as broadcast arms for approved public bulletin messages.
why: This keeps GSN as source of truth while meeting people where they already are.
details: WhatsApp becomes a messenger of the bulletin, not the owner of the community record.
boundary: Automatic posting to external platforms requires permissions, governance and integration support.

title: DemandBox for Structured Need and Demand
status: On-demand action. Canonical spelling: DemandBox.
problem: People ask for work, help, items, support or referrals in scattered messages nobody can organise.
adds: DemandBox turns a need into a structured signal with community context, requester context and response path.
why: Demand tells the community what people actually need, not only what sellers hope to sell.
details: DemandBox can reveal opportunity before a seller spends money stocking the wrong thing.
boundary: DemandBox records a request or signal; it does not prove the requester will buy or the helper can deliver.

title: Ask Community Routed to DemandBox
status: Recent correction target: Ask Community should route to DemandBox, not pollute community bulletin.
problem: If personal asks enter the official bulletin, the bulletin loses authority and becomes a mixed conversation feed.
adds: GSN can keep Ask Community as a structured demand action while preserving bulletin for official messages.
why: This protects both sides: people can ask, and the announcement board remains clean.
details: A member can ask for a mattress, contract help or courier support without burying the chairman announcement.
boundary: The route must be verified in the current app before demo.

title: Private Response Through Contact Paths
status: On-demand/configurable depending on contact fields and public view.
problem: Not every response should happen in public; offers, welfare matters and negotiation often need privacy.
adds: GSN can show the structured public need while allowing interested people to use the approved contact route.
why: Public structure plus private response reduces noise and embarrassment.
details: The public record says what is needed; the private channel handles the personal conversation.
boundary: Private conversations outside GSN are not fully evidenced unless outcomes are recorded back into GSN.

title: Cross-Community Opportunity Movement
status: Capability direction requiring permission and community rules.
problem: A need in one community may be solved by another, but uncontrolled cross-posting creates spam and privacy risk.
adds: GSN can make opportunities portable across approved community boundaries while still attaching context.
why: Opportunity grows when trust and relevance travel carefully.
details: The same request can remain community-scoped while being presented to a permitted outside network.
boundary: No cross-community discovery should happen without rules, consent and route checks.

title: Private Vault and Controlled Offers
status: Partial/on-demand where private vault links exist.
problem: Some offers or records should be shared with a specific person, not the whole community.
adds: GSN can support owner-issued private links or controlled views for sensitive records.
why: Privacy is part of trust. Not everything useful should be public.
details: A private link can carry enough evidence for a decision without exposing the whole account.
boundary: Private link security and expiry behaviour must be verified before sensitive use.

title: Buyer-Seller Terms Before Money or Goods Move
status: Capability direction around TrustSlip, evidence and release-before-payment concepts.
problem: Many disputes begin because people acted before basic terms were clear.
adds: GSN can help present the item, identities, expectations and evidence before action.
why: A small record before movement can prevent a large quarrel after movement.
details: The question changes from do you know him to what evidence is visible before I act.
boundary: GSN evidence supports decision-making; the receiving person decides whether to proceed.

title: Merchant Context Without False Guarantees
status: Automatic/derived where shop, ID and trust records exist.
problem: People either trust blindly because someone is in the group or refuse useful trade because they have no context.
adds: GSN can show merchant context: community link, GSN ID, public shop state, visible records and contact path.
why: Context helps without pretending to be a court judgment.
details: The system can say what is visible without claiming what it cannot prove.
boundary: GSN does not guarantee honesty, delivery, legality or future behaviour.

title: TrustEvents as Activity Memory
status: Automatic/derived where TrustEvent logic is live.
problem: Communities remember drama but often forget ordinary responsible action.
adds: GSN can preserve meaningful activity as events that later support timelines, analytics and trust interpretation.
why: Trust is built from repeated evidence, not one speech.
details: Small responsible acts can stop disappearing.
boundary: A TrustEvent is evidence of recorded activity, not automatic moral proof.

title: TrustTimeline and Long-Term Memory
status: Derived/advanced where timeline surfaces exist.
problem: One record does not show pattern; communities need to see behaviour over time.
adds: GSN can organise evidence into a time-based story of actions, responses and outcomes.
why: Time reveals reliability better than a single claim.
details: The person who quietly does the right thing many times can become visible.
boundary: Timelines are only as good as the evidence captured.

title: TrustPassport From Existing Evidence
status: Automatic/derived where TrustPassport is live. Canonical spelling: TrustPassport.
problem: People are asked to prove themselves again and again in each new setting.
adds: GSN can present a portable trust identity based on eligible existing records, not a self-praise form.
why: Portable evidence helps responsible people carry recognition across contexts.
details: It is not a CV of claims; it is a passport from recorded evidence.
boundary: TrustPassport does not force acceptance; the receiving party decides.

title: Purpose-Specific TrustSlip
status: User triggers on demand from eligible evidence. Canonical spelling: TrustSlip.
problem: Screenshots and broad explanations are too stale, too wide or too easy to misunderstand.
adds: GSN can generate a TrustSlip for a specific purpose using already eligible evidence.
why: The right evidence for the right decision is safer than exposing everything.
details: TrustSlip is generated when needed; it is not a manual profile to fill to look trustworthy.
boundary: TrustSlip presents evidence; it does not command the receiver to trust.

title: Public Verification Links Instead of Old Screenshots
status: On-demand public verification where routes exist.
problem: Screenshots can be cropped, old or misleading.
adds: GSN can provide view or verification links so a receiver can inspect the current public record.
why: Live verification reduces argument over whether a record is real or outdated.
details: A link can be fresher and narrower than a screenshot.
boundary: Public verification must expose only approved public data.

title: Shop Control and Business Analytics
status: Automatic/derived once shop, products, Spotlight and activity exist.
problem: Small sellers confuse effort with result and may not know whether people are seeing, opening or responding.
adds: GSN can summarise shop readiness, public items, Spotlight signals, DemandBox signals and attention indicators.
why: Analytics helps a seller improve presentation before blaming the market.
details: The system can say add one clear public product before judging traffic.
boundary: Analytics measures available signals; it should not claim sales or profit without evidence.

title: Market Wisdom Snapshot
status: Automatic/derived insight layer where Market Wisdom is live.
problem: People need interpretation, not only raw counts.
adds: GSN can turn activity signals into cautious guidance about what appears to be happening and what to do next.
why: Guidance helps people act on evidence instead of guessing.
details: It should remain cautious: evidence first, test second, conclusion later.
boundary: Market Wisdom is guidance, not a final decision or investment promise.

title: Opportunity Engine as Advanced Evidence-Led Analytics
status: Advanced/experimental analytics surface; not a separate setup flow unless the live product requires one.
problem: Communities generate signals every day but rarely connect demand, supply, trust, attendance, trade and repeated needs.
adds: GSN can read across Shop, I Can Help With, DemandBox, Ask Community, Spotlight, Repost, Shop Control, Market Wisdom, TrustGraph, TrustPassport and community context.
why: The highest value may come from seeing what the community is becoming before everybody else notices.
details: It should show lenses, graphs, snapshots and next actions, not one endless text thread.
boundary: Do not expose private graph logic. No CAC/LTV modelling or AI interpretation until deliberately approved.

title: Phone Notifications and Action Alerts
status: Planned/integration capability unless push notifications are confirmed live.
problem: People miss important activity because they do not open the app at the right moment.
adds: GSN can eventually notify the phone when a relevant action happens: bulletin, response, approval, verification request or meeting reminder.
why: Real-time awareness can matter more than another screen.
details: The phone should alert because GSN action happened, like people expect from serious apps.
boundary: Notifications require permission, device support and careful controls to avoid spam.

title: Trust Savings and ROSCA Support
status: Capability direction/non-custodial unless finance workflows confirm more.
problem: Rotating contribution groups depend on memory, social pressure and manual records.
adds: GSN can organise participants, expectations, contribution evidence, turns, reminders and dispute context without holding funds.
why: The trust circle becomes stronger when records are clear.
details: The value is accountability around the money, not pretending GSN is the bank.
boundary: Do not claim custody, lending or regulated financial services unless legally implemented.

title: Contribution Tracking and Reconciliation Evidence
status: Capability direction/non-custodial record layer.
problem: Offerings, dues, levies, school support, project donations and association contributions become contentious when records scatter.
adds: GSN can record contribution expectations, evidence, follow-up and reconciliation context.
why: Financial trust often depends on boring but reliable records.
details: A church offering campaign, school fundraiser or family levy can keep evidence beyond collection day.
boundary: Payment processing, receipts and legal accounting depend on actual integrations and governance.

title: Emergency Support With Accountability
status: Composite/planned depending on current support flows.
problem: Emergencies create urgency, but urgency can create duplicate giving and weak evidence.
adds: GSN can organise the request, responsible contacts, evidence, support commitments and follow-up.
why: Emergency help should move fast without becoming careless.
details: The same record can help now and explain later what happened.
boundary: GSN is not an emergency service and does not replace official responders.

title: Diaspora Trust Bridge
status: Capability direction using identity, public verification, TrustSlip and controlled links.
problem: People abroad want to support home communities but struggle to verify people, needs, projects and outcomes.
adds: GSN can package community identity, records, requests and selected evidence into a bridge that distant supporters can inspect.
why: Distance reduces trust unless evidence travels well.
details: Supporters do not need to be physically present to see a structured record.
boundary: Distant verification still requires judgement and sometimes independent checks.

title: Service Work and Informal Hiring Support
status: Capability direction from shop, service profile, TrustSlip and community evidence.
problem: People hire artisans, carers, drivers, tutors or contractors through informal recommendations with little record.
adds: GSN can show the service offer, community link, available evidence and response route before work starts.
why: Informal work is still serious work. People need context before letting someone into a home, school, church or project.
details: A TrustSlip before work starts can prevent avoidable disputes after work fails.
boundary: GSN does not certify professional qualifications unless verified documents are part of the record.

title: Schools, Youth Groups and Consent-Sensitive Events
status: Audience-specific capability direction requiring strict permissions.
problem: Schools and youth groups need attendance, parent communication, events, follow-up and safeguarding without exposing private details.
adds: GSN can structure announcements, attendance, documents, approvals and follow-up in a governed community space.
why: Youth settings need order and privacy at the same time.
details: A programme notice can carry forms, attendance and follow-up without depending only on a class WhatsApp group.
boundary: Any child or youth use requires safeguards, consent and data minimisation.

title: Church Programmes, Offering, Volunteers and Follow-Up
status: Audience-specific composite capability; payment handling depends on lawful integrations.
problem: Churches manage announcements, services, departments, offerings, welfare, programmes, volunteers and pastoral follow-up across many informal channels.
adds: GSN can structure notices, attendance or availability, documents, volunteer coordination, support records and programme memory.
why: A church is not only Sunday gathering; it is a living organisation with people, records, needs and follow-up.
details: An offering drive or programme can keep its instruction, evidence and follow-up in one governed place.
boundary: GSN must not replace pastoral judgement, safeguarding rules or regulated payment/accounting requirements.

title: NGO and Charity Activity Proof
status: Audience-specific composite capability from projects, attendance, documents, contributions and outcomes.
problem: NGOs and charities need to prove that meetings, outreach, support and outcomes happened, not only that they were announced.
adds: GSN can organise beneficiaries, volunteers, announcements, attendance, support records, documents and follow-up evidence.
why: Funders and partners care about traceable activity and responsible delivery.
details: A small outreach can become a traceable record that helps the next grant conversation.
boundary: GSN activity proof is not an independent audit unless audited by a qualified party.

title: Cooperative and Market Resource Pooling
status: Capability direction using membership, contributions, shops, DemandBox and records.
problem: Groups want to pool resources, bulk buy, share tools or fund projects, but records become political.
adds: GSN can structure who is involved, what is needed, who committed, what evidence exists and what outcome followed.
why: Pooling value requires shared memory and fair visibility.
details: A market association can move from verbal agreement to a traceable resource plan.
boundary: Legal cooperative finance, custody and investment activity require separate compliance.

title: Commitment Builder and Follow-Through
status: Capability direction/derived from tasks, responses and repeated actions.
problem: Communities are full of good intentions that fade because nobody tracks the next step.
adds: GSN can turn intention into visible commitments, reminders, evidence and follow-up.
why: A community improves when people do what they said, not only when they agree in the meeting.
details: Even a small promise becomes part of the trust memory when completed.
boundary: Commitment records must remain fair and correctable; mistakes should not become permanent punishment.
